eyebrow.zh: 整篇配图 · 同一种风格 · 零账号

headline.zh:
贴一整篇中文文章
自动配上一批同风格手绘插图
headline.en:
Paste a whole Chinese article
Get a batch of same-style hand-drawn illustrations

sub.zh: 按段落语义决定在哪配图、配什么，再锁定一种白底怪诞手绘风格整批渲染，导出即贴进公众号 / 小红书。不写代码也能跑。
sub.en: It decides where to illustrate and what each picture shows from the paragraph meaning, locks one white-background hand-drawn style across the whole batch, and exports a drop-in folder for WeChat / Xiaohongshu. Runs without writing code.

title.zh: 读完整篇，再决定哪几段配图
title.en: Reads the whole article, then picks where pictures go

body.zh: 不是机械地每段塞一张图。它先分清哪些是概念、哪些是例子、哪些只是过渡，再挑最值得配图的段落，并为每张图想好画什么——一篇文章出一整套讲得通的图。
body.en: It doesn't stuff a picture into every paragraph. It tells concepts and examples apart from filler, picks the paragraphs worth illustrating, and decides what each picture should show — so one article yields one coherent set.

chips: › 优先给概念 / 例子段配图

title.zh: 整批同一种手绘，像同一只手画的
title.en: One hand-drawn style, across the whole batch

body.zh: 每张图共用同一份风格说明和同一个种子，所以一篇文章的插图看起来出自同一只手——白底怪诞手绘，少量红橙蓝批注。也能切到水墨写意，整篇仍然同手。
body.en: Every picture shares the same style brief and the same seed, so a batch reads as one hand — white-background hand-drawn with a few red-orange-blue notes. Or switch to ink-wash; the whole article still reads as one hand.

chips: › 怪诞手绘 / 水墨写意

title.zh: 先看结果，再决定花不花额度
title.en: See the result before you spend a credit

body.zh: 不用配任何 key、不用登录。一条命令先打印出整篇配图计划，再用占位图跑完整套流水线——你看完满意了，再接你自己的国产出图模型出真图。
body.en: No keys, no sign-in. One command first prints the whole placement plan, then runs the full pipeline on placeholder art — once you like what you see, plug in your own image model for real renders.

title.zh: 封面或整篇，一条命令切
title.en: Cover or whole article — one command

body.zh: 只要一张主视觉封面？用 --cover 从标题语义出一张主图；要整篇配图就去掉它。导出文件夹里有图、有人类可读的贴图标记、和机器可读的映射，照着贴进公众号 / 小红书编辑器即可。
body.en: Want just one hero cover? Use --cover to get a single main image from the title. Want the whole article illustrated? Drop it. The export folder has the images, a human-readable paste-guide, and a machine-readable map — drop it into your editor and go.

chips: › 导出即贴公众号 / 小红书

headline.zh: 装一条命令，给每篇文章配一整套图
headline.en: One install, a whole illustrated article per run

sub.zh: 本地命令行工具，开源、零账号可试，接你自己的国产出图模型出真图。
sub.en: A local command-line tool — open source, keyless to try, and ready for your own image model when you want real renders.
